name: Baku Ane 2 ~Otouto, Ippai Shibocchau zo!~
original_name: ばくあね２ ～弟、いっぱいしぼっちゃうぞ！～
source:
The protagonist fails his first time with his lover due to a past trauma. However, his older sister and cousin decide to help him overcome his trauma through sexual lessons. Moreover, even the person that causes him trauma participates too.

And so the older sisters' contest for the younger brother begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/bakuane2/tam-tipsnote120112/story_bakuane2_.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
由于过去的创伤，主人公与恋人的第一次亲密接触以失败告终。于是，姐姐与表姐决定通过性方面的指导，帮助他克服创伤。就连当初给他留下创伤的人，也加入了进来。

就这样，姐姐们争夺弟弟的较量开始了。

[译自：[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/bakuane2/tam-tipsnote120112/story_bakuane2_.html]官方网站[/url]]
